propositions: BindingStore's 799-line module owns byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and identity rotation with no cohesive internal ownership, causing safety rules to have no designated owner and production code to mutate inner entries via shallow all_bindings() queries

Extract three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) behind unchanged public facade while preserving all byte serialization, JSON formatting, unknown fields, and shallow-compatible all_bindings() behavior

Implement journal-free retirement completion rule where durable tombstone is authoritative intent, live forward/reverse pair is removed only when all three identities agree, and only explicit unretire revokes that intent—never automatic liveness observation

Recovery must run after exclusive lock and staleness validation but before remote issue fetch to prevent upgraded passes from interleaving new liveness evidence with completion of interrupted retirements

All three decomposition slices must be independently revertible internal facade delegations with unchanged stored formats and public signatures; each slice can regress independently to preceding implementation
